var yDe=Object.freeze([[1564,1564],[8234,8238],[8294,8297]]),Qpr=yDe.map(([e,n])=>`\\u{${e.toString(16)}}`+(n>e?`-\\u{${n.toString(16)}}`:"")).join(""),Brt=new RegExp(`[${Qpr}]`,"gu");var bCt=16384;function xIn(e,n){if(typeof Bun>"u"||typeof Bun.ant?.CellSegmenter!=="function")throw Error("This runtime has no Bun.ant.CellSegmenter. Run Claude Code on the @anthropic-ai/bun-internal version pinned in package.json.");return new Bun.ant.CellSegmenter({ambiguousIsNarrow:!0,substitute:e,screen:n})}
export{yDe,Qpr,Brt,bCt,xIn};
